words.meaning: Mutual trust, sociability, and warm friendship among people who spend time together
words.sentence1: The long hours of working together fostered an enduring sense of camaraderie among the crew. (The long hours of working together fostered an enduring sense of camaraderie among the crew.)
words.sentence2: There is an unspoken camaraderie between travelers who meet on the same winding road. (There is an unspoken camaraderie between travelers who meet on the same winding road.)

words.meaning: The relationship of mutual affection, trust, and support between people; friendship
words.sentence1: Nuestra amistad se ha fortalecido con el paso de los anos. (Our friendship has grown stronger with the passing of the years.)
words.sentence2: Ella valora la amistad sincera por encima de cualquier riqueza material. (She values sincere friendship above any material wealth.)

words.meaning: A bond of deep affection, mutual sympathy, and goodwill between persons; friendship
words.sentence1: Une veritable amitie resiste aux epreuves du temps et a la distance. (A true friendship withstands the trials of time and distance.)
words.sentence2: Ils partagent une amitie profonde fondee sur la confiance et le respect. (They share a deep friendship based on trust and respect.)

words.meaning: A profound feeling of emotional connection, solidarity, and close bonding
words.sentence1: Trotz der grossen raeumlichen Trennung spuerten die beiden eine tiefe Verbundenheit. (Despite the great physical separation, the two felt a deep connection.)
words.sentence2: Gemeinsame Erlebnisse schufen ein starkes Gefuehl der Verbundenheit in der Gruppe. (Shared experiences created a strong feeling of connection in the group.)

words.meaning: The enduring emotional ties and bonds that connect people to one another
words.sentence1: Konnan o norikoeta koto de, futari no kizuna wa yori isso tsuyoku natta. (By overcoming difficulties, the bond between the two became even stronger.)
words.sentence2: Kazoku ya nakama to no kizuna wa, jinsei de mottomo taisetsu na mono desu. (The bonds with family and friends are the most precious things in life.)

words.meaning: The reciprocal affection, loyalty, and companionship shared between friends
words.sentence1: La loro sincera amicizia e nata durante l'infanzia ed e durata per sempre. (Their sincere friendship began during childhood and lasted forever.)
words.sentence2: Un gesto di gentilezza puo segnare l'inizio di una meravigliosa amicizia. (A kind gesture can mark the beginning of a wonderful friendship.)

words.meaning: Friendship; the warm, enduring relationship of mutual trust and camaraderie
words.sentence1: Tamende youyi jing shou zhule shijian yu juli de kaoyan. (Their friendship withstood the test of time and distance.)
words.sentence2: Zhenzheng de youyi bu zaiyu xingshi, eryu zai kungan yu gong. (True friendship does not lie in formality, but in sharing hardships and joys together.)

words.meaning: Friendship; the heartfelt affection and loyalty exchanged between friends
words.sentence1: Geudeurui jinsilhan ujeongeun eotteon sigyeneseodo byeonhaji anatseumnida. (Their sincere friendship did not change through any hardship.)
words.sentence2: Oraen sewol dongan ssayeoon ujeongeun mueotgwa do bakkul su eopseumnida. (The friendship accumulated over a long time cannot be exchanged for anything.)

words.meaning: Friendship; the harmonious, benevolent tie connecting individuals in companionship
words.sentence1: Mittapheap pit brakat min ach kat phdach ban daoy sa chhamngay nohe te. (True friendship cannot be severed by distance.)
words.sentence2: Krom niyeuk choeuk cheak tha mittapheap kheang klay chea komlang chhnang bamfot knong chivit. (The team believes that strong friendship is the greatest strength in life.)

words.meaning: Friendship; the state of mutual fondness, loyalty, and companionship between people
words.sentence1: 'n Egte vriendskap word nie deur afstand of tyd verswak nie. (A genuine friendship is not weakened by distance or time.)
words.sentence2: Hulle het 'n lewenslange vriendskap gebou wat op wedersydse vertroue rus. (They built a lifelong friendship based on mutual trust.)
